messages:
zoe.partnerships: Quick sync regarding marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Focus: CC-free trial UX, SKU mapping, publisher IDs, and a short SI + hardware add-on blurb. Need final artifacts for partner preview next week.

alan.legal: CC-free trials are OK with two controls: 1) abuse throttles + opt-in billing prompt before trial expiry, 2) clear refund/termination language for auto-conversions. I'll prepare EN/DE/FR snippets and a short privacy blurb (DPA link included).

pri.product: SKU proposal: `redwood-saas-starter` (14d trial, metered), `redwood-saas-commit` (monthly + overage), `redwood-edge-addon` (one-time hardware). Suggest exposing bundle SKU `redwood-saas-bundle` for marketplace discovery. Metering unit = per-10k-token-block.

zoe.partnerships: Good. Marketing needs a 90-char listing headline + hero image + 12s demo GIF. Also need a short SI paragraph: "Redwood certified integrators offer deployment & migration services."

myles.ops: Ops status: AWS sandbox publisher ID = RBW-AWS-SBX-81 (ready). GCP publisher request in progress; Azure tenant verification queued. Webhooks to register: `/marketplace/provision` & `/marketplace/entitlements`. We'll need TLS client certs for vendor calls. Example manifest I used: ```json
{
  "offerId": "redwood-inference-2026",
  "publisherId": "<vendor-publisher-id>",
  "skus": ["redwood-saas-starter", "redwood-saas-commit"],
  "metadata": {"eu_data_only": false, "supports_vpc": true}
}
```

alan.legal: Quick policy note: AWS needs explicit data residency toggle for EU-only processing. Add `eu_data_only` metadata and a one-line privacy blurb in each vendor listing. Also redact provisioning payload logs to avoid storing PII.

pri.product: Draft listing billing line: "14-day trial, then $0.00035 per token unit (10k = $3.50)." I'll put example invoice lines in the PR and a 2-min quickstart with curl examples.

design.team: Asset-bot created placeholders: hero_placeholder.png + demo_placeholder.gif. We'll finalize visuals after marketing copy.

asset-bot: assets:upload queued (job id: assets-20260620-11). ETA 2024-06-20T20:00Z.

zoe.partnerships: Action items: 1) @alan.legal finalize localized T&Cs + DPA and trial clause by Tue 12:00 UTC. 2) @pri.product lock SKU slugs + pricing + invoice examples by Mon EOD. 3) @myles.ops complete AWS private-offer test + GCP manifest submission by Mon midnight. 4) @design.team deliver hero + GIF by Wed EOD. Follow-up sign-off Thu 10:00am PT in #partnerships.

myles.ops: I'll post sandbox logs tonight. If GCP throws metadata warnings, I'll open infra ticket.

alan.legal: Uploading T&C v1 now. Will add short opt-in billing snippet for non-CC trials.

zoe.partnerships: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — I'll assemble the partner preview packet once items are complete. Drop updates here if anything blocks."
